# T9 — Evidence

Project: T9 — TOGAF ADM capability · Track: v2 · Tranche: 4 · Plan: docs/SPEC_V2.md §12 / docs/plans/T9-architecture-capability.md
Unit: #387 (the unit that publishes this output)
Measured at: main@36b9b60d, 2026-11-19 · Project row: closed

## Claim

The TOGAF ADM capability and its two console surfaces are delivered, and the programme's own adoption of the capability is recorded. PR #350 (`c8204432`) landed the capability — eleven tenant-scoped, FORCE-RLS tables and a 29-action family — together with the app's four-tab Architecture screen at `/architecture`. PR #401 (`36b9b60d`) landed the three read actions, the public snapshot's `architecture` section and the design pack's live Architecture destination. The programme then adopted the capability against itself: a tailored profile, an approved standard, an approved artefact set, a board with a decision, maturity and skills assessments, ten published documents, and an independent compliance review recorded at level compliant. The public snapshot section is delivered by #401; the image roll and its live verification are pending.

## Evidence

**Merges.** PR #350 `c8204432` (merged 2026-11-18; issue #81 closed 2026-11-18) — the capability and the app screen. PR #401 `36b9b60d` (merged 2026-11-19; issue #385) — the three read actions, the snapshot section and the pack destination. The documents are published under programme unit #387.

**Tables and actions.** `migrations/0054_architecture.sql` creates eleven tables: `artifact_type`, `adm_profile`, `governance_body`, `architecture_contract`, `architecture_artifact`, `architecture_artifact_entry`, `architecture_artifact_link`, `architecture_compliance_review`, `architecture_waiver`, `architecture_maturity`, `architecture_skill_assessment` — all tenant-scoped, ENABLE and FORCE RLS. `crates/actions/src/architecture.rs` registers 29 actions: the 26 from #350 plus `architecture.maturity_list`, `architecture.skills_list` and `architecture.board_list` from #401. `crates/store/src/architecture.rs` holds the invariants and the write paths `seed_standard_tx`, `advance_phase_tx`, `assert_design_contract_tx`, `decide_board_tx`, and the reads `list_maturity_tx`, `list_skills_tx`, `list_bodies_tx`.

**Surfaces.** `apps/web/src/screens/architecture.rs` is the four-tab screen with live invokes and the phase-advance refusal, routed at `/architecture` in `apps/web/src/app.rs`; this is D6's surface. `docs/design/v2.js` is the pack's Architecture destination: signed in it reads the live rows through the read actions, signed out it renders the snapshot, and `?design=1` keeps the study. `crates/store/src/snapshot.rs` emits the public `architecture` section — profiles, standard, artefacts with entries, links, contracts, board, maturity and skills — filtered to programme-bound projects. The snapshot section is delivered by #401; the image roll and its live verification are pending.

**Adoption rows (read back 2026-11-19).** Board `01a1f2c0-b22a-7e27-a6cc-1a8e48db327e`; decision approval `01a1f2c8-e26f-79ce-a082-5526648a47c5`; profile `conveyor-software-delivery` adopted v3; PF-1 catalogue `01a1f2c1-5717-75e7-9b3d-1d7707648c09` with 10 entries, approved v2; derivation `01a1f2c1-94ad-7a92-8aca-57202f48ece9` with 7 edges; realization `01a1f2c1-9c75-78a2-a2a4-647687dfbe10` with 10 edges; both links recorded; statement of architecture work `01a1f2c2-0e1a-787f-9011-46b424d1ec71` live v2; maturity group `01a1f2c2-3e8c-730f-906d-cd2baf65722a` with mean 2.2/5; skills group `9ce8e8d6-d665-47b6-bde7-4dcf33411686` with six roles across 42 rows.

**Published documents.** Ten, unit #387: inception-analysis `01a1f2dc-89e9-77ae-9321-b57ad2e28d09`, architecture-design `01a1f2dc-b68d-723f-9b89-1760c32f25a6`, architecture-principles `01a1f2dc-db53-7729-b0f1-686bcf81a1e4`, adm-profile `01a1f2dd-0583-73fe-a8b5-7d1166116f4a`, artifact-standard `01a1f2dd-1e74-77e9-8b11-1ab87a0db7fa`, architecture-artifact `01a1f2dd-3623-701c-b0ba-169d83d7907a`, statement-of-architecture-work `01a1f2dd-5c13-73b9-845e-3f1673585e1e`, maturity-assessment `01a1f2dd-74a7-739d-96e9-edc665a7b847`, skills-assessment `01a1f2dd-99d8-74fa-9f71-b02b976b4521`, waiver `01a1f2e0-d72c-776e-b137-a48ad1560663`.

**Compliance review.** Recorded 2026-11-19 by an independent reviewer session — not the documents' author — against the live statement of architecture work: approval row `01a1f357-69eb-7716-811e-ce22ea93d496`, level compliant, D1–D6 all pass with the findings carried in the closure review.

**Tests (merged, by `path::test_name`).** `crates/api/tests/architecture_artifacts.rs` — `a_catalog_is_queryable_rows`, `an_approved_artefact_is_immutable`, `reuse_is_searchable_across_plateaus`. `crates/api/tests/architecture_capability.rs` — `the_profile_names_the_mandatory_set`, `a_maturity_assessment_needs_every_dimension`, `a_skills_assessment_names_its_role`, `maturity_list_returns_every_assessment_dimension`, `skills_list_returns_one_entry_per_role`, `board_list_returns_the_opened_body`. `crates/api/tests/architecture_compliance.rs` — `one_level_and_a_dated_waiver`. `crates/api/tests/togaf_architecture_phases.rs` — `phases_a_to_f_pass_in_order`, `a_draft_artefact_refuses_the_contract`, `a_contract_change_reopens_the_gate`. `crates/api/tests/togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs` — `a_delivery_project_without_a_contract_cannot_pass_design`, `a_superseded_contract_refuses_design`, `a_live_contract_opens_the_design_gate`. `crates/api/tests/togaf_h_change.rs` — `a_scope_change_produces_a_change_register_row`, `an_unrecorded_review_refuses_the_gate`. `crates/actions/tests/parity_http_mcp.rs` and `registry.rs` carry the new actions (registry 472, internal 454).

**Recorded runs at the merged head.** The `architecture_capability` target passed; `rbuild -- test -p conveyor-actions --test registry --test parity_http_mcp` 12 and 7 passed; `rbuild -- test -p conveyor-api --lib` 29 passed. Full workspace at the pre-merge head: 420 of 421 binaries green; the single failure (`copilot_identity`, an inference-mock 502 under load) passed 6/6 in isolation; the docker-only Redis flush test was skipped locally and passed in CI. `rbuild --fmt` clean; clippy passed in the gate; `cargo audit` 0 vulnerabilities (6 allowed warnings).

**Gates and CI.** Design-pack gates: check-console 412/401, check-v2 248, check-studio 233, check-learning 139, check-workbench 119, check-architecture 147; data/doc gates and no-private-refs clean. PR #401's required contexts all succeeded; merge_group `ci` run 44501468428 succeeded, then merged.

## Verification

From a checkout of `origin/main`:

```
git show origin/main:migrations/0054_architecture.sql
git show origin/main:crates/actions/src/architecture.rs
rbuild -- test -p conveyor-api --test architecture_artifacts
rbuild -- test -p conveyor-api --test architecture_capability
rbuild -- test -p conveyor-api --test architecture_compliance
rbuild -- test -p conveyor-api --test togaf_architecture_phases
rbuild -- test -p conveyor-api --test togaf_delivery_design_gate
rbuild -- test -p conveyor-api --test togaf_h_change
rbuild -- test -p conveyor-actions --test registry --test parity_http_mcp
gh run view 44501468428 --repo nonagenticai/conveyor
curl -s https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/data/snapshot.js | grep -c '"architecture"'   # 0 until #401's image rolls
```

The Rust tests run through `rbuild`, the sanctioned route on this estate, each provisioning a Postgres 18 database and failing closed without one. The last command verifies the pending surface: the live snapshot returned `git_sha ba70b428` with no `architecture` section at measurement.

## Links

- Programme record: issue #387 (T9 documents, open), issue #81 (capability, CLOSED 2026-11-18), issue #385 (read actions, CLOSED), PR #350, PR #401.
- Plan and gate: `docs/plans/T9-architecture-capability.md` §5 D1–D6; `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 row T9.
- Published documents (unit #387): the ten ids listed above.
- Public snapshot: https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/data/snapshot.js — `git_sha ba70b428` at measurement; the `architecture` section appears only after #401's image rolls.

## Gap

- **Ten types, no type-create.** The seeded artefact standard ships ten types and no action adds one; `seed_standard_tx` is the only write path. Phases E–H have no mandatory types, and Phase E's advance passes an empty requirement set.
- **Board lifecycle.** The board row's `status` stays `draft` while its decision is an approval row; there is no lifecycle transition.
- **Duplicate maturity group.** An identical duplicate maturity assessment group `01a1f2ca-fdf6-7698-b685-e1e94dd454be` exists from a read-back; the store exposes no assessment delete action.
- **PF-1 document link.** PF-1's artefact `document_id` is null. An approved artefact is immutable, so linking the published principles page needs a supersede plus a fresh board approval — an owner decision.
- **Read-only pack.** The design pack's Architecture page is read-only; the writes live in `apps/web`. If the pack must write, that is a separate unit.
- **D5 selector.** The plan-named selector `a_systemic_finding_produces_a_kata_candidate` does not exist; the substance is covered inside `a_scope_change_produces_a_change_register_row`.
- **Lifecycle event literals.** The four names — `architecture_artifact.changed`, `architecture_phase.closed`, `compliance_review.recorded`, `architecture_waiver.granted` — are declared in the plan and asserted at the module level; no literal emission site was found by grep.
- **No live phase advance.** No phase advance has been exercised on a real architecture project; D3 is proven by tests only.
- **D6 correction.** The compliance reviewer wrote that the public snapshot already carried an `architecture` section. Measured after the review, `https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/data/snapshot.js` returned `git_sha ba70b428` with no `architecture` section, and the three read actions were not registered live: PR #401 is merged at `36b9b60d` but its image had not rolled at the time of writing. D6 is unaffected — its criterion is the app's Architecture screen, live since `c8204432` — and this record does not repeat the reviewer's snapshot claim.
- **Image roll.** The image roll and live verification of #401's read actions and snapshot section are pending.
